from.place: ## Proof: the identification of E_infinity with the associated graded pieces used to compare the graded map with the E_infinity map

title: The half-plane graded identification is the canonical one
statement: Let $(D,E,\alpha,f,g)$ be an exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple] satisfying the hypotheses of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence], with $A^n=D^{0,n}$, the filtration $F^pA^n$ [def-sp-filtration] and the isomorphisms $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^pA^{p+q}/F^{p+1}A^{p+q}$ stated there, and $Z_\infty$, $B_\infty$, $E_\infty$ as in [def-sp-convergence]. Let $p\geq0$, $q\geq a$ and $n=p+q$. Then $g:D^{p,q}\to E^{p,q}$ lands in $Z_\infty^{p,q}$, and the composite $\gamma:D^{p,q}\to Z_\infty^{p,q}\to E_\infty^{p,q}$ and the composite $\varphi:D^{p,q}\xrightarrow{\alpha^p}F^pA^n\to F^pA^n/F^{p+1}A^n$ are both epimorphisms with the same kernel. The isomorphism $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^pA^n/F^{p+1}A^n$ of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence] is the one they induce, i.e. it carries $\gamma$ to $\varphi$.

source.place: Lemma 12.21.4 (Tag 011T, description of Z_r, B_r) and Lemma 12.23.5 (Tag 012F, E_infinity and the associated graded)

proof.text: Fix $p\geq0$, $q\geq a$, $n=p+q$, and choose $r>\max(q-a+1,p)$ so large that $u:=p-r+2\leq0$; put $v:=q+r-2$, so $u+v=n$. By [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence] the entry has stabilized from page $r$ on, so $E_r^{p,q}=E_\infty^{p,q}$. By item 4 of [lem-sp-derived-couple-exact], $C_r$ is an exact couple of type $r-2$ with $D_r^{u,v}=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^{r-2}:D^{p,q}\to D^{u,v})$ and $D_r^{p+2,q-1}=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^{r-2}:D^{p+r,q-r+1}\to D^{p+2,q-1})=0$, since $q-r+1<a$. Exactness of $C_r$ at $E_r^{p,q}$ and at $D_r^{u,v}$ gives the exact sequence $D_r^{u+1,v-1}\xrightarrow{\alpha_r}D_r^{u,v}\xrightarrow{g_r}E_r^{p,q}\to0$. For $k\leq0$, $\alpha:D^{k,m}\to D^{k-1,m+1}$ is an isomorphism by exactness of [def-sp-exact-couple], since $E_2^{k-2,m+1}=0$ and $E_2^{k-1,m+1}=0$ (negative first index); hence $\alpha^{-u}:D^{0,n}=A^n\to D^{u,v}$ is an isomorphism carrying $G_qA^n=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^p)$ onto $D_r^{u,v}$ and $G_{q-1}A^n=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^{p+1})$ onto $\alpha_r(D_r^{u+1,v-1})$. So the sequence identifies $E_\infty^{p,q}$ with $G_qA^n/G_{q-1}A^n=F^pA^n/F^{p+1}A^n$.

source.place: ## Proof: the identification of E_infinity with the associated graded pieces used to compare the graded map with the E_infinity map

proof.text: Under the identification of Step 1 the map $\gamma:D^{p,q}\to E_\infty^{p,q}$ is induced by $g$: iterating the defining property $g'\circ\bar\alpha=\pi\circ\hat g$ of item 2 of [lem-sp-derived-couple-exact] gives $g_r(\alpha^{r-2}y)=\overline{g(y)}$ for $y\in D^{p,q}$, and $g$ factors through $\ker d$ on each page, so $g(y)$ is a cycle on every page and lies in $Z_\infty^{p,q}$ [def-sp-convergence]. The map $\varphi$ is $\alpha^p:D^{p,q}\to D^{0,n}=A^n$ followed by $F^pA^n\to F^pA^n/F^{p+1}A^n$. By Step 1, both are the composite of $D^{p,q}\twoheadrightarrow G_qA^n$ with the quotient $G_qA^n\to G_qA^n/G_{q-1}A^n$, transported by the isomorphism $\alpha^{-u}$; hence both are epimorphisms with the same kernel.

Two epimorphisms out of $D^{p,q}$ with the same kernel induce a unique isomorphism $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^pA^n/F^{p+1}A^n$ carrying $\gamma$ to $\varphi$, i.e. $\overline{g(y)}\mapsto\overline{\alpha^p(y)}$; this is the canonical isomorphism of weak convergence in [def-sp-convergence] (here $A^n=D^{0,n}$ is the stable value of the colimit, as $\alpha$ is an isomorphism in first degree $\leq0$, and $F^pA^n=\operatorname{im}\alpha^p$). The isomorphism $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^pA^{p+q}/F^{p+1}A^{p+q}$ of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence] is not specified further in that statement; the present lemma fixes it to be this canonical isomorphism, which by Step 2 exists and carries $\gamma$ to $\varphi$.

lean.statement: theorem halfPlaneGradedCanonical (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) (a : ℤ) (hD : ∀ (p q : ℤ), q < a → IsZero (X.D p q)) (hE : ∀ (p q : ℤ), (p < 0 ∨ q < a) → IsZero (X.E p q)) : ∃ L : LimitSubobjects X, ∃ A : ∀ n : ℤ, AlphaColimit X n, ∃ hA : ∀ n : ℤ, (A n).obj = X.D 0 n, ∃ hConv : X.ConvergesTo L A, ∀ (p q : ℤ), 0 ≤ p → a ≤ q → (L.Z p q).Factors (X.initialG p q) ∧ Epi (X.toPageInfinity L p q) ∧ Epi (X.toGradedPiece A p q) ∧ kernelSubobject (X.toPageInfinity L p q) = kernelSubobject (X.toGradedPiece A p q) ∧ ∃! e : X.pageInfinity L p q ≅ (X.imageFiltration (p + q) (A (p + q))).gradedPiece p, X.toPageInfinity L p q ≫ e.hom = X.toGradedPiece A p q
